csmt-utxo-the-existing-engine.text: The linked CSMT-UTXO revision already follows the chain, maintains current UTxO commitments and serves inclusion proofs, historical roots and address lookup. Its documented schema has no transaction archive. The table separates reusable machinery from additional anchor publication work and ledger-provider indexes, archive, retained views, leases and refusals. The packaging choice remains open. Measure the workloads separately; the old CSMT lane stays paused.

application-consumers.text: MPFS and Singular remain application consumers. The existing MPFS verifier consumes backend facts. Replay from transaction CBOR needs a deterministic interpreter and complete dependencies. The linked acceptance run will test that proposed integration after implementation.

assess-the-evidence.text: Use the decision record for evidence boundaries, the roadmap for next demonstrations and the availability page for service commitments.
